versions.changelog:
Initial release of threads-publisher—publish posts and threads to Threads by Meta.

- Enables publishing of text, photo/video, carousel, and multi-post threads to Threads.
- Supports replies, scheduling, and automatic splitting of long content into threads.
- No local credentials required; uses a secure MCP Server URL with embedded auth.
- Handles media uploads from local files, URLs, and Google Drive.
- Provides detailed error handling and usage documentation.
